# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

He is stolid and suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. He takes pride in driving with girls he admires, though he offers little laughter or chatter during trips.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Traits

- Stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- Uncommunicative  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## History

Billy Andrews drove a party of Avonlea youth—including his sister Jane, Diana, and Anne Shirley—to a concert in White Sands in his family's double-seated buggy. During the drive, he insisted that Anne sit beside him on the front seat because he admired her immensely and felt puffed up with pride to be seen with her.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Relationships

### Jane Andrews

- Sibling of — Brother of Jane Andrews  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006)</sub>

### Anne Shirley

- Friend of — Admires Anne immensely and insisted on driving her to the White Sands concert  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
